resources.string: Your prayers, in rhythm with your day. Precise times, a gentle reminder, and space to reflect.
Private by design. No account, no ads, no location uploads. All prayer calculations happen on your device.
Location sets your prayer times. Allow approximate or precise location, or enter coordinates below. Salatuk never tracks you continuously.
Leave empty to follow the device time zone. City and country are optional local labels.
Enter valid coordinates and an IANA time zone.
A licensed standard recording is included. Import your own permitted Makkah or Madinah recording to enable those voices. Audio stays on this device.
Uses your alarm volume. Salatuk never changes system volume or overrides Do Not Disturb.
Reminders are approximate and may be delayed in battery-saving mode. Adhan uses a separate exact alarm.
Umm al-Qura calendar; local moon observations can differ.
Allow alarms and reminders in Android settings so Adhan can start while your screen is locked or your phone is idle. Without this access, automatic Adhan is unavailable.
Allow notifications to see prayer reminders and playback controls. You can continue without notification permission.

If an alarm is missed, check exact-alarm access, battery optimization, alarm volume, notification channels and Do Not Disturb. Some manufacturers (Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei) add their own "sleeping apps" or "auto-start" battery limits on top of Android\'s -- search your phone\'s battery settings for Salatuk and allow it to run unrestricted in the background. A force-stopped app cannot run alarms until you open it again. After restarting the phone, unlock it once.
Android battery optimization can stop Salatuk before it plays the Adhan, especially with the screen off. Exempt Salatuk so it always runs on time.
The Adhan plays on your alarm volume, which is currently muted. Raise it so you don\'t miss a prayer.
Open Salatuk to set your location
Location unavailable. Check permission and location services, or enter coordinates manually.
Could not restore alarms. Open settings and check exact-alarm access.

Prayer times are unavailable for this date and location. At polar latitudes, consult your local mosque for a suitable timetable.
